focus: Adversarial continuation of the August 1952 election-enforcement chain, with emphasis on what the surviving public records do and do not prove.

documents_directly_opened.provenance: National Institute of Korean History, Data on Korean History vol.26; contemporary Dong-A Ilbo, 1952-08-06
documents_directly_opened.finding: The full text states that a Liberal Party Central Election Countermeasures Committee complaint was filed on August 4 against Prime Minister Chang Taek-sang, Home Minister Kim Tae-son and Public Security Bureau director Yun, alleging presidential/vice-presidential election-law and civil-service-law violations. Prosecutor General Han Kyok-man said investigation would begin; the report says prosecutor 李禎雨 would handle it. The text itself gives non-identical complainant-name formulations, so the roster remains conflicted pending the original complaint.

documents_directly_opened.provenance: National Archives of Korea, institutional history
documents_directly_opened.finding: Official chronology places 윤우경 as 치안국장 from 1952-05-25 through 1952-09-16. This independently fixes the August complaint's surname-only 윤치안국장 as 윤우경.

documents_directly_opened.provenance: Academy of Korean Studies, Encyclopedia of Korean Culture
documents_directly_opened.finding: 윤우경 (尹宇景), 1900-1995; police official who served as Seoul police chief and Home Ministry Public Security Bureau director. The entry also records a June 1952 instruction through the surveillance section to monitor National Assembly members.
한격만 became the fourth Prosecutor General on 1952-03-14, independently anchoring his institutional authority during the August complaint.

documents_directly_opened.provenance: National Institute of Korean History; contemporary Chosun Ilbo, 1952-05-12 reporting May 10 statement
documents_directly_opened.finding: Han Kyok-man publicly announced prosecution facts in the Seo Min-ho case in May 1952, independently confirming his active prosecutorial/public-announcement role before the August election dispute.

documents_directly_opened.provenance: National Institute of Korean History; contemporary Seoul Sinmun, 1952-07-12
documents_directly_opened.finding: Han Kyok-man described disciplinary action involving Seoul High Prosecutors' Office chief Kim Sang-jin and prosecutor O Je-do. This is useful institutional context but does not establish the disposition of the August election complaint.

documents_directly_opened.provenance: National Institute of Korean History, 1952-08-12 day index
documents_directly_opened.finding: The index explicitly lists '金泰善 내무장관, 선거사범 일체 수사 중지를 지시'. It proves the indexed report exists and its topic/date, but the publicly indexed view does not expose recipient, legal basis, exceptions, implementation, or prosecution compliance.

adversarial_checks.claim: The Liberal Party complaint proved the accused officials violated election law.
adversarial_checks.result: REJECTED. The contemporary item proves a complaint and planned investigation, not guilt or disposition.

adversarial_checks.claim: The August 12 index proves prosecutors obeyed Kim Tae-son's halt instruction.
adversarial_checks.result: NOT PROVEN. Compliance and institutional recipient remain open.

adversarial_checks.claim: Kim Tae-son was the same official as the complaint's 윤치안국장.
adversarial_checks.result: REJECTED. Kim was Home Minister; National Archives independently identifies Yun U-gyong as Public Security Bureau director.

adversarial_checks.claim: The complainant roster can be normalized from the August 6 text alone.
adversarial_checks.result: REJECTED. The text contains two non-identical name formulations.

adversarial_checks.claim: 윤우경's June legislator-surveillance instruction proves his conduct alleged in the August election complaint.
adversarial_checks.result: REJECTED. It establishes a separate surveillance lead, not the elements of the August complaint.

adversarial_checks.claim: Han Kyok-man's officeholding is dependent only on the newspaper report.
adversarial_checks.result: REJECTED. Supreme Prosecutors' Office official history independently anchors his tenure.

adversarial_checks.claim: The assigned prosecutor 李禎雨 is biographically resolved.
adversarial_checks.result: NOT PROVEN. Personnel disambiguation is still required.

adversarial_checks.claim: The August 12 instruction was necessarily lawful because it came from the Home Minister.
adversarial_checks.result: NOT PROVEN. Statutory authority and the boundary between police and prosecutorial investigation must be reconstructed from then-current law and records.

adversarial_checks.claim: The August 12 instruction necessarily covered the August 4 complaint.
adversarial_checks.result: NOT PROVEN. Temporal proximity is insufficient without recipient/scope text.

adversarial_checks.claim: The absence of a recovered disposition means the complaint was dropped.
adversarial_checks.result: REJECTED. Absence of accessible disposition evidence is not evidence of termination.

remaining: Recover the full August 12 article or original newspaper image.
Recover the original August 4 complaint and reconcile complainant names.
Identify prosecutor 李禎雨 through 1952 prosecution personnel records.
Find docket/disposition evidence for the complaint.
Determine whether the August 12 halt order was directed to police only, prosecutors, or both, and whether it was implemented.
